tasks.title: Наблюдения невооруженным глазом: поиск звезды по критериям
tasks.statement:
Find the object corresponding to the following criteria:
- The object is the second brightest star in its constellation.
- The object is visible approximately 28 degrees from a UMi.
- The equatorial coordinates of the object are: RA 11h, dec +62°.
Answer the questions:

parts.question: What is the Bayer designation (e.g. β Ori) of the identified object?
Write the name of the constellation in Latin, which the object is visible in.

tasks.title: Наблюдения невооруженным глазом: угловое расстояние
tasks.statement: What is the angular distance between Vega (α Lyr) and Albireo (β Cyg)?

parts.question: What is the angular distance between Vega (α Lyr) and Albireo (β Cyg)?

tasks.title: Наблюдения невооруженным глазом: координаты и зенитное расстояние
tasks.statement: Find horizontal coordinates and zenith distance for specified stars.

parts.question: Find the horizontal coordinates of Thuban (α Dra).
Find the zenith distance of Alcor (near ζ Ursae Majoris).

tasks.title: Наблюдения в телескоп: двойные звезды
tasks.statement: There are 3 binary stars on the given sky chart: β Cyg, δ Lyr, and ε Lyr. For each of the binaries do the following: Point the telescope to the binary. Compare the star field seen in telescope’s field of view with three star charts given on a separate sheet. Write down the designations of the binary stars in each blank box under appropriate star chart. Mark North direction on every star chart.

parts.question: Write down the designations of the binary stars in each blank box under appropriate star chart and mark North direction.
